saw_lines: Nobody buys an aircon until the heat arrives, then they compare price and delivery in one sitting.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where price and delivery get answered before the buyer scrolls.
Your 16 ads with fixed copy carry no proof number, so buyers lack a reason to choose you. Collect a review count, or orders shipped, and open three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: None of your 16 ads with fixed copy carries a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to choose you. Collect one figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open three ads with it.

4 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the unit in the ad. That extra search is where buyers drop off. Point each one to its exact product page, such as the Haier Real ECO or the Samsung AR40.

Your 16 ads with fixed copy open with 12 different stories, and the biggest leads only 3. Buyers never see one message often enough to remember it. Keep the home comfort and empty room openers, and build three variations of each.

18 of your ads have run 60 days or more, so you have proven winners. Their angle has held attention that long, so copy it. Build three variations of the oldest winner with new opening lines and fresh visuals.

ads_1: Two rebuilt openers on delivery and price, each carrying one proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
